message.content: The sea typically looks blue—especially when it’s clear and calm—but its color can shift depending on depth, weather, time of day, and the presence of algae or sediment. In shallow waters it may appear turquoise or greenish, while in deep ocean it can look almost black. So while “blue” is the classic answer, the sea’s hue is actually a spectrum that changes with conditions.
